Spacecraft name Deorbitsail

Status Semi-operational? Was operational until 2019-05-19 checked on 2019-05-24. Sail not deployed due to high spin rates. (Last SatNOGS report 2019-05-19, but no data. Last JA0CAW report 2016-01-14 had correct telemetry. Later reports have no or corrupt telemetry)

Deployer ISIPOD [ISISpace]

Institution Space agency
Entity type Government (Civil / Military)

Launch brokerer ISILaunch
Partners Caltech, EADS Astrium, Stellenbosch University, University of Patras, Athena-SPU, ISISpace, DLR (German Aerospace Centre), Surrey Satellite Technology (SSTL)
Costs $3,200,000 for the whole project and consortium including platform and launch
Oneliner

Deploy a 5-metre solar sail to demonstrate deorbiting.

Description

Launch and deploy a 5-by-5-metre, four-quadrant solar sail to demonstrate deorbiting.

Failure cause Very high spin rates prohibited the deployment of the solar sail.
